title: OTTO
description: OTTO's official Design System publishes basic and semantic colour tokens with hex: primary OTTO red (#f00020), blue (#008ffd), white (#ffffff), near-black (#222222), greys (#f0f0f0, #e6e6e6, #c4c4c4, #777777), plus semantic sustainable green (#7ea87b), hint yellow (#ffdf33), and success green (#50cc7f).
